title: Microwave cannons used to bring down craft (Jake Barber / Northrop Grumman)

tellings.quote: if you look at Jake Barber, the psionics and all of that and you know, the Northre Grumand connection, they have in their possession a lot of those microwave cannons.

plain: Michels says that people tied to Jake Barber, a man linked to "psionics" (the claimed use of mind powers), and to Northrop Grumman, a large American weapons maker, have a lot of microwave cannons. He raises it himself to suggest those weapons could be used to bring down unknown craft.
